textRuns.value: Most customers that are being given discounts(71.59%) are not loyal customers and they were given a total discount of $4474.89.
Florida was the leading state in the discounts given, indicating many purchases were made there, hence it is advisable to try and retain those customers to become loyal customers.
A good number of items were purchased in Florida(775K) indicating there is a good number of customers who should be retained and become loyal customers.
